option_relations.rationale: Post-viral keratitis is a general term and does not directly relate to the specific leaf disease.
Post-viral immune-mediated interstitial keratitis is a specific condition and does not directly relate to the leaf disease.
Chikungunya virus–associated keratitis is a subtype of Chikungunya virus infection.
Chikungunya virus-induced bilateral stromal keratouveitis is a subtype of Chikungunya virus infection.
